Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations offset slight historical drawdown.

Silver.note: Strong solar panel demand balances macroeconomic headwinds and historical underperformance.

Copper.note: Structural supply deficits and electrification demand outweigh near-term China property weakness.

Uranium.note: Persistent structural supply deficit and global nuclear renaissance support premium pricing.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply from new global projects outweighs long-term EV battery demand growth.

Nickel.note: Continued surge in Indonesian supply and weak stainless steel demand pressure margins.

Zinc.note: Tight concentrate markets and European smelter curtailments support refined metal premiums.

Iron Ore.note: Softening Chinese steel demand and ample seaborne supply limit upside potential.

Coal.note: Thermal coal demand faces long-term structural decline despite near-term price resilience.

Rare Earths.note: Strategic supply chain shifts and EV motor demand provide a floor despite opaque pricing.

Manganese.note: Steady steel alloy demand balances against limited pricing visibility and stable supply.

PGM.note: Internal combustion engine decline pressures long-term demand despite hydrogen fuel cell upside.

Potash.note: Elevated global inventories and normalized supply chains offset steady agricultural demand.

Aluminum.note: Chinese smelter capacity caps and rising green energy demand tighten the supply balance.

Diversified.note: Strong exposure to copper and gold offsets structural weakness in iron ore and coal.
